title: Local-first network-access boundary
summary: Worktrunk is local-first: the network is touched only when the user asked for it. The audit keys on the calling command, not a fixed blocklist — an egress (`git fetch`, `git ls-remote`, `gh`, `glab`, `az`, HTTP) is a violation when it sits in a fast command or a synchronous hot path (a shell prompt) that cannot absorb the latency, or in a background TTL-cache refresh. A foreground command the user runs and waits on may reach the wire for the activity it was asked to perform, and must still paint its first frame from local data — network-derived detail streams in behind it. Sanctioned activities: CI status (`wt list --full`, `wt list statusline`, and plain `wt list` when `[list] columns` names `ci`); the interactive `wt switch` picker, the most forgiving home for forge data because its lifetime is bounded by the user rather than the job — per-row CI status, the per-row `gh pr view --json comments` / `glab api …/notes` that fills a row's `comments` tab, and the `gh pr list` / `glab mr list` plus per-row previews behind `wt switch --prs`; branch-summary and commit-message generation (`commit.generation` commands); PR/MR resolution (`wt switch pr:`/`mr:`); and the `wt config show --full` version check; plus the one detection-helper exception — the first `Repository::default_branch()` per repo may fall through to `git ls-remote`, caching into `worktrunk.default-branch`. Silent lookup fallthroughs (alias dispatch, hook context build, recovery) must stay local. See AGENTS.md > Network Access.

ownedFiles.reason: default_branch(): the one sanctioned ls-remote fallback and its worktrunk.default-branch cache

`wt list statusline`: runs on every prompt but is not a fast command — Claude Code consumes its output asynchronously — so its CI-status egress is sanctioned; audit only that it adds no other unrequested network work

contextFiles.reason: PR/MR fetch: the legitimate user-invoked egress, must not run on background paths
picker forge fetches (`spawn_pr_previews`, `spawn_comments_fetch`): sanctioned because the picker paints before they start and its exit cancels whatever is unfinished

CI-status egress: where `gh`/`glab` spawn for `wt list --full`, `wt list statusline`, a `ci` column, and the picker's per-row status — the sanctioned calls `statusline.rs` and the picker reach the wire through
Cmd: where external commands (git, gh, glab) spawn
alias dispatch must resolve locally, no fallthrough to the wire
